messages:
sarah: Quick heads-up — Jordan's I-9 flagged: passport expiry in 2 weeks and the address on the DL doesn't match offer. Jordan is remote (AUS, GMT+10). Day 1 is next Monday. @nora can we do a virtual notary + courier badge, or do we need an exception?

nora: You can do virtual notary + courier for badge as long as we collect one primary + one secondary ID and log the notary cert. Need manager sign-off for the address mismatch.

jordan: I can do a mobile notary on Wed 9am my local time (GMT+10). I also have my signed offer PDF and a utility bill for address. Is that ok?

sarah: That should be fine. Please upload the offer and utility bill to the secure intake link I just DM'd. We'll record the notary session in the onboarding folder.

bg-check-bot: Background check update: identity verification pending — awaiting uploaded docs. Criminal + employment screens complete.

kevin: For laptop/badge — we can courier badge on receipt of notary cert. Laptop will ship to the verified address on file. Jordan, confirm if laptop can be left with concierge or needs signature.

jordan: Would prefer signature only. Concierge isn't available at my building after hours.

nora: Ok noted. We'll mark 'signature required' in the shipping notes. @kevin I'll need the courier carrier preference (DHL/UPS) and a shipping SLA; Jordan is on timezone tightness.

kevin: DHL works. We'll aim to ship Thu EOD to hit Mon Day 1. I'll log tracking in the onboarding sheet.

sarah: Day 1 schedule: 09:00 PT onboarding call (calendar invite incoming), 10:30 PT benefits overview (self-enroll window opens that day). Jordan, watch for the benefits enrollment email with the link and personal code.

jordan: Got it — will be online for the 09:00 PT call (that's 02:00 my time but I can do it). Quick Q: deadline to enroll in benefits?

nora: New hires have 30 days from start to enroll. We can provisionally enroll basic plans if you need help during the window.

sarah: Also assigning an onboarding buddy: @kevin will be the buddy for first week (tech/setup). I'll assign product buddy after we confirm manager.

nora: Docs checklist (please upload to the secure intake link):
```
- Primary ID: passport (not expired) OR state DL + SSN card
- Secondary ID: utility bill OR bank statement (dated within 60 days)
- Signed offer PDF
- Mobile notary certificate (if using virtual notary)
```

sarah: Manager (Hiring Lead) approved address exception for courier as long as utility bill uploaded. @jordan once you upload, I'll mark identity verified and trigger badge courier.

bg-check-bot: Reminder: ID verification timeout in 72h if docs not uploaded.

jordan: Uploaded offer + utility bill and booked notary for Wed 09:00 local. I attached the notary appointment confirmation in the intake link.

nora: Received — thanks. I'll review after the notary completes. If everything matches we'll trigger badge + laptop ship.

kevin: I'll prepare the laptop image and send a short pre-config checklist 24h before ship. Jordan, expect a Slack DM from me for final delivery notes.

sarah: Great coordination — I'll update the Day 0 checklist and calendar invites. Ping here if anything changes. :thumbsup:
